name: Kuro Youkyou no Majuu
source:
In Nilfheim Imperial Capital Arena grief and humiliation repeat every day.
Main character is summoned as a fighter to the arena. He lives together with beasts and slave girls and becomes witness to atrocities happening there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
尼尔菲姆帝国首都的竞技场中，悲伤与屈辱日复一日地重复。

主人公被召唤为竞技场的战士。他与野兽和奴隶女孩一起生活，见证那里发生的暴行。
